extractions.description: Introduces and evaluates ConceptGraphs, an inference-only system that combines off-the-shelf vision, vision-language, and language models to construct open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs and use them in robotic perception and planning tasks.

type.quote: We implement and demonstrate ConceptGraphs on a number of real-world robotics tasks across wheeled and legged mobile robot platforms.
type.justification: The paper implements the system and reports quantitative and real-robot experiments.

name.quote: We propose ConceptGraphs, a 3D scene representation method for robot perception and planning
name.justification: The paper explicitly claims a contribution to robot perception and planning.

name.quote: We construct open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs; efficient and structured semantic abstractions for perception and planning.
name.justification: Open-vocabulary 3D scene-graph construction is a central contribution.
